official_guidance_sources.title: YouTube Help — Thumbnail & title tips
official_guidance_sources.takeaway: Target the viewer clearly; text should be easy to read.

official_guidance_sources.title: YouTube Help — Spam, deceptive practices, & scams policies
official_guidance_sources.takeaway: Titles and thumbnails must not mislead viewers about what appears in the video.

official_guidance_sources.title: Digital Agency Japan — Web Accessibility Statement
official_guidance_sources.takeaway: Use JIS/WCAG accessibility thinking for older viewers and readable text.

official_guidance_sources.title: MEXT — Web Accessibility
official_guidance_sources.takeaway: Readable images require good contrast and readable font choices.

observed_patterns: Numbered checklist titles are common for possession/preparation topics.
Words like 保存版 and 完全版 are common but can feel too broad or heavy for this calm channel.
Senior bag-content videos often use direct object imagery and simple text.
Hospital-prep titles can become too fear-based; this package should soften the hook.
recommended_patterns_for_channel: Use a number anchor with a clear hospital-visit context.
Keep thumbnail text to two or three short Japanese words.
Show a clinic bag, card pouch, and medicine notebook-like object, not a hospital emergency.
Use gentle_concern emotion rather than shock.
patterns_to_avoid: 知らないと損 used too strongly
医者は教えてくれない
panic face or red emergency marks

selected_package.description_ja:
通院の日の朝、診察券やお薬手帳を探して慌ててしまうことはありませんか。
この動画では、受付で必要なもの、診察で伝えるもの、待ち時間を少し楽にするもの、帰り道まで安心して過ごすためのものを、五つのまとまりで確認します。

ご紹介する内容は、毎日の暮らしの中でできる準備の見直しです。薬や水分制限などについて不安がある場合は、主治医や薬剤師にご相談ください。

#通院準備 #シニアの暮らし #お薬手帳 #持ち物チェック #ひとり暮らし
selected_package.description_vi: Mô tả nhấn vào việc chuẩn bị đồ đi khám theo 5 nhóm: giấy tờ tiếp nhận, sổ thuốc, ghi chú trao đổi với bác sĩ, đồ dùng khi chờ, và đồ hỗ trợ đường về. Có disclaimer mềm về thuốc và hạn chế nước.
selected_package.thumbnail_prompt_nano: Generate a YouTube thumbnail in retro-clean 2D illustrated lifestyle handbook style. A clearly senior Japanese person with gray hair and gentle concern stands at a Japanese genkan beside an open clinic bag, a blank card pouch, and a medicine notebook-like object. Large readable Japanese thumbnail text: 忘れ物チェック. Warm soft colors, high readability, simple composition, no fake official document details, no panic, no medical emergency.
selected_package.why_selected: The number-anchor title states the exact value of the script, while the thumbnail answers the opening viewer question about forgetting items on a clinic morning. It is specific enough for click clarity and calm enough for the channel's safety tone.
